name: Mickey’s frontage and bar-read pilot batch
scope: 12 work packages; includes named component requirements, not a complete pub. Shell/access preview is prerequisite for fitted parts. Individual private door, WC and full upstairs inventory remain phase 2. No automatically generated placements.

common.units: metres; dimensions [width,height,depth] in glTF +Y up, front -Z
common.pivot: author at bounds centre; studio placement uses measured bounds centre, never placement scaling
common.mesh_lane: one untextured slot per GLB, zero images; slot0 is replaced by existing surface. Rich finishes require separate compatible pieces or future interface work
common.uv: provisional 512px/m near player; seams on rear/underside; no mirrored lettering. Static lane ignores authored textures; retain UV0 for future use
common.collision: per-item proposal; Claude binds in piece data, never guessed GLB metadata
common.budget: no engine-derived budget. Aim no more geometry than silhouette needs; compare pilot to measured source, then profile. No mass exports.
common.placement_rotation: Right-hand yaw about source +Y; yaw0 faces source -Z/west; +90 faces -X/south. Bounds-centre positions are design proposals, never live placements.
